reference_context.section: Logging library > API Reference > ESP_LOGE; Overview
reference_context.snippet: This macro cannot be used when interrupts are disabled or inside an ISR. @see ``ESP_DRAM_LOGE``. [Overview:] There are also ``ESP_DRAM_LOGx`` versions for each of these macros, e.g. :c:macro:`ESP_DRAM_LOGE`. These versions are used in some places where logging may occur with interrupts disabled or with flash cache inaccessible.

expected.root_cause: ESP_LOGI is called inside the ISR; the logging path takes a lock and blocks, so the interrupt watchdog fires.
expected.fix: Remove logging from the ISR: set a flag or send to a queue with xQueueSendFromISR and log in a task (or use ESP_DRAM_LOGI).
